title: Concrete common source prefix
statement: For a commutative ring Λ in Type(u+1), schemes W,S, k:W→S, a module sheaf G on W, q∈N, U∈S.Etale, A,B∈Over(W), f:A→B and a module raw derived class z at B, construct the morphism from the abelian single source at A to derived abelian inverse image of the derived forgotten shifted module coefficient at B. It is abelianSourceFactor(f.left,B.hom≫k,A.hom≫k) followed by derived abelian inverse image of scalarSourceFactor at B composed with the derived forgotten z. This is explicit categorical composition and involves no coefficient comparison tail.
